claims.statement: The company aims to train 10 lakh people through its skilling process this year.
claims.quote: this year, as we kind of go ahead, we are gunning for training almost 10 lakh people.

claims.statement: Management targets maintaining the current growth momentum and high-single-digit volume band for Q4.
claims.quote: I think as we go ahead, this band would remain, in terms of what we would be able to target for the Q4 as well.

facts.statement: Standalone net sales growth was about 2.9% for Q3, with a volume growth of almost 8%.
facts.quote: If you see that the Net Sales growth is about 2.9%, I think a little bit lower here because of the festive season being cut short. But, the volume growth has been strong at almost about 8%.

facts.statement: Standalone gross margin for Q3 reached about 44.9%, higher by 200 bps year-over-year.
facts.quote: when we look at the gross margin, one of the highest Gross Margins I would say over the quarters in terms of what we have registered, about 44.9%, 200 bps points higher

facts.statement: Standalone PBDIT margin for Q3 was 21.4%, which is 100 bps up year-over-year.
facts.quote: the PBDIT margins are also quite good at 21.4%, 100 bps up yoy.

facts.statement: Exceptional items for Q3 include a labour code impact of Rs. 63.74 crores and an impairment of Rs. 94 crores in White Teak (Obgenix Software Private Limited) at a consolidated level.
facts.quote: one is all of you are aware, the impact of the labour code, which basically has a component in terms of gratuity and leave accumulation. And that is something which is Rs. 63.74 crores. As I mentioned that while we got the top line in White Teak the month of October was not good. I think the whole bottom line was affected here. So, we have to take another impairment here, and that has been something which is close to about Rs. 94 crores which has been taken in White Teak which is the Obgenix Software Private Limited.

facts.statement: The company has implemented regionalized product strategies across 8 to 9 states including J&K, Kerala, West Bengal, Karnataka, and Haryana.
facts.quote: We now cater to almost about 8 to 9 states where we have taken different kind of products. The products vary from upgradation emulsions to premium emulsions to luxury emulsions. We have also introduced waterproofing variants coming in various regional packs. So, to name a few states, we have done it in J&K, we have done in Kerala, we have done in West Bengal, we have done in Karnataka, we have done in Haryana.
